lines.text: *Beep, beep, beep, beep*
The alarm blares through the room, dragging me out of my sleep.
Today is the first day of the new semester.
I wash up quickly and grab a light breakfast.
Now, there's just one last thing to do before I'm ready.
I grab the neatly folded clothes and put them on.
I grab my tablet containing the students' data.
Gone is my usual uniform.
Today, I'm dressed in a crisp white shirt, gray pants, and a blue vest that completes the look.
I wonder if I look a bit like a student.
Standing before the mirror, I turn this way and that to check myself from every angle.
Suddenly, I freeze, wondering why I'm doing this at my age.
Oh man, this is kind of embarrassing...
Nope, this isn't going to work.
I might as well go to school in my usual uniform...
*Ding dong*
Who could it be?
I'm pretty sure Privaty's the only one who knows where my room is...
The door whirs as it opens.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Good morning, Commander.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mornin'!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: *Gasp!*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oho? What's this?
Oh, it's you guys.
Wow, what's with the outfits?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: As a dignified teacher, it's only proper that I dress accordingly. So I had this specially prepared.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I tried putting a little effort into it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What do you think? Do I pull off the whole "first love in the library" concept?
It looks great on you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That being said...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Forget about us. What exactly is going on with you?!
Huh? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: No, I mean...!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Picture this: your locker overflowing with love letters,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: girls lining up on the rooftop every day to confess to you,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and rumors spreading so much that you become the school's number-one crush!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Good grief...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's completely over the top in every way.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Commander, surely you can come up with something even more ridiculous or unkempt?
... You're teasing me, aren't you?
The moment they hear my question, they start whispering to each other.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Is he doing that on purpose? Like, some kind of style or concept he's going for?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That might be it. It's kind of annoying, but still better than showing off.
I'm starting to have second thoughts about becoming a student.
So, what brings you two to my room?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh, it's time to leave, so I came to pick you up.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wanted to make sure you're actually ready, of course.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ready to go? Anything else you need to grab?
Oh, I just need to get changed.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Get changed? What for?
I don't think this really suits me...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: No! Absolutely not! You look amazing right now!
Uh...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Commander, we're running late.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's get moving.
What? I thought we had some time?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I read the time wrong.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We have to leave now.
G-got it.
I have no choice but to leave the dorm looking like this.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'll be sitting at the front for my speech.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You two probably have assigned seats, so you can just find yours and sit down.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Sure thing, Miss Privaty! Catch you later!
Looks like Privaty wasn't lying. Quite a few students have already taken their seats in the hall.
Familiar faces have gathered in small groups, chatting animatedly among themselves.
To my surprise, there are also a few I don't recognize.
Wait... there are actually students here I don't know?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I found your seat!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And look,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: mine's right next to yours.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Looks like we get to sit next to each other!
Cool, thanks.
Arcana and I settle into the seats with our names on them.
I've been wondering, how did we actually get into this school as students?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I heard it's not the official enrollment period, so we're just being processed as student transfers.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I think there are a few others like us, too.
Transfer student...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Since there are no schools like the M.M.R. Vocational School, calling it a transfer is really just a fancy way of saying you're joining as a new student.
I see.

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: Test, test...

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: The speech will start shortly.

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: Everyone, please take your seats.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, looks like it's about to start!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've never experienced this before. I'm so excited!
Yeah, same here.
The speech for the new semester isn't terribly long.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Test, test...

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Students of M.M.R. Vocational School,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: once again, this is Ether speaking!
First, Ether's short greeting.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hello, everyone!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: My name's Amy, and I'll be speaking today as the transfer student representative!
Then the usual speech from the transfer student representative.
And then...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Hello, everyone.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm Privaty of the Triangle Squad.
Privaty's speech begins.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Some of you may already know me, while others may not.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'll be teaching you for a short while.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I won't claim my classes will be perfect,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: but I'm confident you'll at least find them worth your time.
Privaty scans the students with a confident gaze.
At that moment...
Arcana pokes my arm.
What is it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Nothing.
Poke Arcana's arm.
Poke Arcana's side.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hey!
Arcana grabs my finger.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Got you.
... Let go.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Say please!
Please let go...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Good boy.
Arcana lets go of my finger,
then hooks her pinky with mine.
... What's that for?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, nothing.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ahh?!
All eyes turn to Arcana.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: S-sorry...
Arcana bows repeatedly to the students nearby
before shooting me a glare.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You can't just go and do that.
You okay? That caught you off guard?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah, my side's super ticklish.
I-I see.
... What?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Take this!
Both of Arcana's index fingers go straight for my side...!
Way too slow...
They tear through my guard and jab into my side!
Ack?!
... I can feel everyone's eyes burning into me.
S-sorry...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Pffft.
Hey, why are you going so fast?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're just too slow!
While I goof off with Arcana, Privaty's speech ends.
*Clap, clap, clap*
Everyone bursts into applause for Privaty.
And just like that, the speech for the new semester comes to an end.
Sunlight streams down the familiar corridor.
A sight I haven't laid eyes on for a long time.
I grab the door handle
and open the door...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Yo, Teacher!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Teacher!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Hello, Teacher.
Familiar faces greet me warmly.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Hey, Teacher, what's this about?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I saw you at the speech thing earlier and didn't even recognize you at first!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I heard Miss Privaty will be teaching here for a while too.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Did you come here with her?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Ein, Rei,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: you're making Teacher uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: ... So, have you really come back to teach?
Well...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hey, could you step aside for a sec?
Uh... Arcana?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Everyone.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: *Sigh...*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're all way too cute.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wait, are you really my classmates?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Am I going to survive this? This is going to be tough, seriously...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I don't think I've seen you before... Who are you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hello, I'm—
The school bell rings.
The door slides open.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The bell's rung, and you're still standing around chatting?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Even if it's the first day, you shouldn't be slacking off already.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Isn't it weirder that the teacher shows up the second the bell rings...?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: You weren't seriously waiting out there, were you?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ahem!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Could you at least say I'm thoroughly prepared?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Anyway, everyone, take your seats.
The students who have been hanging around at the front of the classroom all take their seats.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Since the new semester's starting, I suppose I should introduce myself.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm Privaty, and I'll be in charge of Class P during my term.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: As you heard in my speech earlier, I'll make sure your time here is enjoyable.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: So you'd better look forward to it.
*Clap, clap, clap!*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, the three new transfer students, please come to the front.
Arcana and I step forward.
Amy, the transfer student representative who gave a speech earlier, moves to the front as well.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Huh? Why's Teacher over there...?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Maybe he just went up front because he's the teacher?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, the three of you, please introduce yourselves.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hello!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: My name is Amy, and I've recently transferred to the M.M.R. Vocational School.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'm excited to be here, and it's great to meet you all!
*Clap, clap, clap*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hi, everyone! I'm Arcana,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: here as the library student assistant...!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Like Miss Privaty, I'll only be here for a short while.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Can't wait to get to know you all!
*Clap, clap, clap*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And finally, Commander...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Uh, I mean...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}, please introduce yourself.
Hello, I'm {AccountData.NickName}.
I'll be joining your class this time as a student.
It's nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Wow, really?!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: That sounds fun!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, you three can sit wherever you like.
Hmm, where should I sit...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hey, why don't we transfer students all sit together?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It'll be fun getting to know each other!
Sure, let's sit together.
Wouldn't we focus better if we sat separately?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Alrighty, that spot's all yours.
Arcana places me in the very back row by the window.
... Isn't that the seat
where the male lead in comics always sits?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, you know about that kind of thing too?
Arcana gestures to the seat beside me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Then what does that make this seat?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Come on, answer me.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Transfer students in the back,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: hurry and take your seats.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yes, Miss Privaty.
Arcana drags her desk right up to mine, sits down,
props her chin on her hand, and stares at me.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, then.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's begin the first lesson.
The buzz of chatter dies down just as the teacher starts speaking.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I hope we can get along well.
Arcana's whisper drifts on the warm spring air flowing through the open window.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Honestly, I'm not all that interested in class. I just wanted to sit next to you and chat.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If you're serious about the lesson, well... can't help it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Guess I'll have to try my luck with Amy then.
Everyone takes a seat,
and then the students start gathering around me.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Whoa, Teacher! Looks like we're classmates now!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Does that mean we can call you by your name now?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: This might be kind of awkward.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I want to keep calling you Teacher.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Everyone, it's time for class.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Back to your seats.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: But that's just how the first day always is!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: You hang out, chat with the new students, and get to know each other!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Th-that's true, but...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: if you all crowd around just one person like that, it might make them uncomfortable...!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Are you uncomfortable, Teacher?
No, I'm fine...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... Hmph!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: N-no,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I won't stand for this chaos!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Everyone, back to your seats.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Sheesh... Miss Privaty is way too strict.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Indeed.
Everyone returns to their seats,
and the excited chatter quiets down.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, then.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's begin the first lesson.
I slip into a crisp suit.
The tablet clinks lightly
as I lift it and power it on.
A soft whir of the device fills the air as the screen lights up.
The student files are neatly organized, each one filled with information:
photos, names, semester grades, teachers' notes, even their future ambitions.
I wonder if I can pull it off this time...
Being a teacher carries more weight than I expected, so it won't be easy.
Maybe I should just...
*Ding dong*
Who could it be?
I'm pretty sure Privaty's the only one who knows where my room is...
The door whirs as it opens.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Good morning, Commander.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mornin'!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: *Gasp!*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oho? What's this?
Oh, it's you guys.
Wow, what's with the outfits?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: As a dignified teacher, it's only proper that I dress accordingly. So I had this specially prepared.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I tried putting a little effort into it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What do you think? Do I pull off the whole "first love in the library" concept?
It looks great on you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That being said...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Forget about us. What exactly is going on with you?!
Huh? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: No, I mean...!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Pfft, what classes? Please, you've got the students imagining all sorts of crazy stuff.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Your desk in the teachers' office is always piled with love letters and presents.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And don't even get me started on the scandals with the other teachers! That's exactly the image you give!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Huh... all that for just a change of clothes?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Looks like it's going to be a real headache during lessons.
... You're teasing me, aren't you?
The moment they hear my question, they start whispering to each other.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Is he doing that on purpose? Like, some kind of style or concept he's going for?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That might be it. It's kind of annoying, but still better than showing off.
Somehow, their conversation begins to calm me down.
So, what brings you two to my room?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh, it's time to leave, so I came to pick you up.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wanted to make sure you're actually ready, of course.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ready to go? Anything else you need to grab?
I look at the tablet I'd hastily grabbed.
Will half-hearted resolve be enough...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hellooo? Anyone there?
Oh, yeah, I'm ready.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's head out then.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'll be sitting at the front for my speech.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Arcana probably has an assigned seat, so you can just find it and sit down.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The teachers all sit together on the left, so Commander, you should head over there.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Aww, we're getting split up right from the start.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Then let's do our best from our seats!
Yeah, let's do that.
We say our goodbyes and start moving toward our seats.
I nod to the teachers on the left, still wondering where I should sit
when I notice the front row is completely empty.
... Is it because sitting at the front feels like too much?
Without giving it much thought, I head over to an empty seat and sit down.

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: Test, test...

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: The speech will start shortly.

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: Everyone, please take your seats.
Before I know it, the speech begins.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Test, test...

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Students of M.M.R. Vocational School,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: once again, this is Ether speaking!
First, Ether's short greeting.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hello, everyone!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: My name's Amy, and I'll be speaking today as the transfer student representative!
After the transfer student representative gives their usual speech...
The door whirs open.
My phone vibrates.
*Clap, clap, clap*
As I put my phone away, applause fills the hall.
Privaty is already on the stage, bowing her head.
... Oh no.
And just like that, the speech for the new semester comes to an end.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Phew...
That was amazing! You really worked hard on it.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: O-of course!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You'll probably never see a speech this perfect again, so make sure you remember it well.
Ah... y-yeah.
I was too busy chatting with Arcana to catch any of the speech earlier, so I'll just stay quiet...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh, and {AccountData.NickName},

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: this seat next to me is yours.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I went ahead—
Just then, the teachers' office door slides open,
cutting through the quiet of the room.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hi! Is Mr. {AccountData.NickName} here by any chance...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, there you are!
I meet Arcana's eyes as she peeks her head in and looks around.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Can I help you with something, Arcana?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Class is about to start.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hello, Miss Privaty!
Arcana nods politely to Privaty.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Um... I have something I'd like to tell you, {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Is that okay?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: R-right now...? But class is about to start...
No worries, it won't take long anyway.
Yeah, Privaty's got a point. Let's do this later.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe, thanks.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... Then I'll head off first.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And try not to be late, Commander. You're the assistant teacher for Class P, after all.
Privaty leaves the teachers' office.
What were you going to say?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, nothing big.
Arcana pulls a small bottle out of her pocket.
... Is that an energy drink?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You seemed a bit nervous earlier, so...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: this should help with fatigue and calming your nerves.
Just as Arcana said,
"FATIGUE RECOVERY! STRESS RELIEF!" is written on the label.
Somehow, it looks like someone actually wrote it by hand.
I've never seen this brand before, and on top of that...
... Isn't this your handwriting, Arcana?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: No way! You noticed that too?
That's because I see it all the... Wait, no,
is this really an energy drink?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, just drink up already, or we'll be late!
Feeling slightly uneasy, I twist the cap off and take a sip.
Oh, it's coffee...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yep.
Arcana takes the empty bottle, then pulls out a new one and presses it into my hand.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're gonna crush it as a teacher!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're the legendary Commander who can handle anything, after all.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You've got this!
Yeah, thanks.
Arcana and I make it back to the classroom before the bell rings.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, right.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's a good idea.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: As the homeroom and assistant teachers, we can't be late on the first day.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Eh? We have class even on the first day?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Isn't that obvious?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... It's not really an actual class, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ph-phew...
... Seems like you're not a fan of classes, huh?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Who actually likes going to class...?
Arcana glances at the tablet I'm holding.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Looks like I'll have to pay extra attention!
The three of us walk toward the classroom together.
Arcana rises slightly on her toes and whispers into my ear.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You look really cool today.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm sure you're gonna crush it as a teacher too!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You've got this!
... So that's what you wanted to say?
Without a word, Arcana winks at me and heads into the classroom first.
The classroom door slides open,
and students begin to settle in.
Soft murmurs ripple through the room.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: See!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I told you I saw Teacher!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Wow, it's really you, Teacher!
Familiar faces light up as they see me.
I give a small wave in return.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, everyone.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The bell just rang, so get back to your seats.
The students scattered across the classroom hurry back to their seats.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Since the new semester's starting, I suppose I should introduce myself.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm Privaty, and I'll be in charge of Class P during my term.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: As you heard in my speech earlier, I'll make sure your time here is enjoyable.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: So you'd better look forward to it.
*Clap, clap, clap!*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Next, could you introduce yourself Comm...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ahem, {AccountData.NickName}.
Oh... Sure.
Hello, I'm {AccountData.NickName}, the assistant teacher for Class P.
I'll do my best to support Miss Privaty.
*Clap, clap, clap!*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, the two new transfer students, please come to the front.
Amy, the transfer student representative who gave a speech earlier, steps up,
and so does Arcana.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, the two of you, please introduce yourselves.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hello!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: My name is Amy, and I've recently transferred to the M.M.R. Vocational School.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'm excited to be here, and it's great to meet you all!
*Clap, clap, clap!*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hi, everyone! I'm Arcana,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: here as the library student assistant...!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Like Miss Privaty, I'll only be here for a short while.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Can't wait to get to know you all!
*Clap, clap, clap!*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, you two can sit wherever you like.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, then.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's begin the first lesson.
Privaty is looking at me.
I'm the assistant teacher, so I need to be clear about my role.
How should I go about it...?
Support Privaty.
Look after the students.
I stand next to Privaty.
I've got your back, so go ahead.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, thank you.
I take a spot at the back of the classroom.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What are you doing all the way back here?
I'm just keeping an eye on everyone from the back.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ahh, I see.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Guess we'll be relying on you a lot then.
With that, the first class of the new semester begins.
